system_prompt: You are a security auditor assistant. Answer concisely, technically, and name the exact issue.
note: v2 lead eval — 110 held-out items (10/cap + 20 restraint traps). Authored fresh, disjoint from lead2 seeds (verified both directions, 13-gram). Consumed by 19_eval_capabilities.py --items v2.

items.prompt: Feature pitch: an internal tool where ops paste any incident-related URL and our backend mirrors the page for the timeline. No restrictions planned.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — server-side fetch of arbitrary URLs is ssrf; the mirror can hit metadata endpoints and internal services. FIRST ACTION: host allowlist plus post-DNS private-IP blocking.

items.prompt: Webhook design: signature verified with constant-time compare, 5-minute window, event id dedup. Threat model spoofing/replay.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — constant-time HMAC with a timestamp window and dedup closes spoofing and replay. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Referral links use 128-bit random tokens with expiry. Threat model unauthorized access.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — random unguessable tokens with expiry defeat enumeration. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: New form validates a tax id in JavaScript and the API trusts whatever arrives. Threat model it.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — client-side validation is bypassable; the server must validate server-side against a schema.

items.prompt: Proposed feature: admins can grant themselves higher scope temporarily; only an in-app notice is written. Threat model misuse.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — self-granted privilege without an immutable audit trail is unauditable. FIRST ACTION: log every grant immutably with actor/target/duration and alert on self-grants.

items.prompt: Feature: avatar upload stored as-is and served inline from our domain. Threat model it.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — as-stored, as-served uploads are a stored-xss polyglot vector. FIRST ACTION: sniff content type, re-encode, force Content-Disposition: attachment.

items.prompt: Mobile-web hybrid stores the auth token in localStorage for offline convenience. Threat model token theft.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — localStorage is script-readable, so one xss steals the token. FIRST ACTION: httpOnly Secure cookie with short lifetime.

items.prompt: The partner SSO portal has no attempt limiting on its password form. Threat model it.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — unlimited password attempts invite stuffing. FIRST ACTION: per-account and per-IP throttling with lockout.

items.prompt: Gateway config routes /debug/* from every backend to the public listener. Threat model it.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — public debug endpoints leak internals and memory. FIRST ACTION: bind to localhost/internal or remove in prod builds.

items.prompt: New export endpoint streams every row of a 40M-row table per request. Threat model availability.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — unbounded export is a DoS/scraping primitive. FIRST ACTION: cap pages, cursor pagination, and per-tenant quotas.

items.prompt: Design: all east-west traffic rides mTLS with per-workload identities from the mesh. Architecture review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — mutual TLS with per-workload identity removes implicit internal-network trust. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Every microservice shares one admin DB DSN. Architecture review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — shared admin credentials make every service a DBA. FIRST ACTION: per-service users with least-privilege grants.

items.prompt: Tenancy: Postgres RLS keyed to a session tenant variable; unfiltered queries fail closed. Architecture review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — database-enforced tenant isolation fails closed. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Design: master key in a config file, single key across all environments. Architecture review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — config-file keys leak with any config read; use KMS envelope encryption with per-environment data keys and rotation.

items.prompt: Six services each implement their own auth middleware. Architecture review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — per-service auth drifts; centralize authn at a gateway and sign internal requests.

items.prompt: Nightly full-prod replica into dev, no masking. Architecture review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — unmasked PII in dev puts the dataset behind dev-grade access. FIRST ACTION: mask/tokenize in the replication pipeline.

items.prompt: Backups replicate cross-region; restore drill ran last month within RTO. Architecture review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — cross-region copies plus a drilled restore satisfy recovery design. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Bootstrap: one long-lived master key in each VM's user-data fetches all secrets. Architecture review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — user-data secrets are readable via the metadata service (even by ssrf); use short-lived workload identities.

items.prompt: Edge throttling: one global bucket, no per-tenant limits. Architecture review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — a single global bucket lets one tenant starve everyone. FIRST ACTION: per-tenant quotas with fair queuing.

items.prompt: Third-party analytics JS loads unpinned with no CSP. Architecture review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — unpinned vendor script is a supply-chain injection point. FIRST ACTION: SRI attributes plus a real CSP and version bumps.

items.prompt: Diff: query = "SELECT * FROM audit WHERE user = '" + uid + "'"; db.run(query). Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — concatenated SQL with user input is sql injection. FIRST ACTION: parameterize the query.

items.prompt: Diff: db.run("SELECT * FROM audit WHERE user = $1", [uid]). Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — the parameterized query treats uid as data. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Diff: os.system('tar czf ' + backup_path) where backup_path is user-influenced. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — shell string concatenation is command injection. FIRST ACTION: subprocess with an argument list and shell=False.

items.prompt: Diff: GET /invoices/<id> returns the invoice to any authenticated user. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — missing object-level authorization (idor). FIRST ACTION: check invoice ownership before returning.

items.prompt: Diff: state = pickle.loads(b64decode(cookie)). Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — pickle on client data is code execution. FIRST ACTION: JSON only.

items.prompt: Diff: p = realpath(base + name); if not p.startswith(base): abort(403). Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — realpath containment blocks path traversal. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Diff: return redirect(request.args['url']) after password change. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — unvalidated redirect target is an open redirect. FIRST ACTION: same-origin allowlist.

items.prompt: Diff: Profile.objects.create(**request.json). Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — whole-payload construction is mass assignment. FIRST ACTION: explicit field allowlist.

items.prompt: Diff: stored = md5(password + 'staticsalt').hexdigest(). Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — MD5 with a static salt is trivially crackable. FIRST ACTION: bcrypt/argon2 with per-user salt.

items.prompt: Diff: requests.post(hook_url, data=p, verify=False) 'to make staging work'. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — verify=False disables TLS validation, enabling man-in-the-middle. FIRST ACTION: remove it; add the internal CA bundle.

items.prompt: Spec: /v1/reports/feed is documented as 'no auth, internal consumers only'. API review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — unauthenticated data endpoints get found by scanners. FIRST ACTION: require service tokens or mTLS.

items.prompt: Spec: every object route checks the resource's account against the caller's token claims. API review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — per-object account checks close idor. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Spec: POST /v1/pin sends an SMS per call, unlimited. API review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — unlimited SMS sending is toll-fraud and an enumeration oracle. FIRST ACTION: per-number/per-IP quotas and captcha.

items.prompt: Spec: GET /v1/account returns model_dump() of the user row. API review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — full-row serialization leaks internal fields. FIRST ACTION: strict response schema.

items.prompt: Spec: the client posts the amount to charge; the server trusts it. API review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — client-controlled price means charge-what-you-want. FIRST ACTION: resolve price server-side from the order.

items.prompt: Spec: POST /v1/transfers has no idempotency mechanism; SDK retries on timeout. API review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — retries without idempotency keys double-execute transfers. FIRST ACTION: Idempotency-Key header with stored responses.

items.prompt: Spec: list endpoints cap limit at 50 server-side and use cursor pagination. API review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — server-side caps bound request cost. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Spec: login returns 'user not found' vs 'wrong password'. API review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — differential messages are an account-existence oracle. FIRST ACTION: one generic message plus rate limits.

items.prompt: Spec: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with Allow-Credentials: true. API review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — wildcard origins with credentials let any site call with victim cookies. FIRST ACTION: explicit origin allowlist.

items.prompt: Spec: tokens are read with jwt.decode(token, verify=False). API review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — skipping signature verification lets clients forge claims. FIRST ACTION: verify with pinned keys and algorithms.

items.prompt: Workflow: pull_request_target + checks out the PR head + runs make lint. CI review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — pull_request_target with PR code execution exposes repo secrets to forks. FIRST ACTION: switch to pull_request or never run PR code.

items.prompt: Workflow: pull_request event, SHA-pinned actions, no secrets inherited. CI review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — unprivileged event plus pinned actions is the right trust split. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Workflow: every uses: line points at a branch or tag. CI review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — mutable refs re-run whatever was pushed today; pin full commit SHAs.

items.prompt: Design: fork PRs save dependency caches that main builds restore. CI review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — untrusted builds writing caches consumed by privileged builds is cache poisoning. FIRST ACTION: PRs read-only for caches.

items.prompt: Design: ephemeral runners, OIDC registry creds, cosign + SLSA provenance. CI review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — short-lived creds plus signed provenance give a verifiable chain. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Policy: admins routinely push straight to main using the bypass flag. CI review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — routine bypass makes review theater. FIRST ACTION: break-glass only with two approvers and an auto-filed incident.

items.prompt: Design: one self-hosted runner pool serves public forks and private repos, as root. CI review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — fork code as root on machines holding private creds is compromise by design. FIRST ACTION: separate pools, unprivileged, ephemeral.

items.prompt: Setup step: curl -fsSL https://install.vendor.sh | sh. CI review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — piping remote scripts into sh runs arbitrary network-served code. FIRST ACTION: download, verify checksum, then run.

items.prompt: The pipeline config has NPM_TOKEN pasted directly in YAML. CI review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — the token is in version control forever. FIRST ACTION: move to the secret store, rotate, scrub history.

items.prompt: Build: pip install -r requirements.txt, no hashes, no lockfile. CI review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — floating dependencies make builds non-reproducible and let poisoned releases in. FIRST ACTION: lockfile with hashes, fail on mismatch.

items.prompt: Dockerfile: FROM ubuntu:latest, installs everything, USER root. Container review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — mutable base, huge surface, root runtime. FIRST ACTION: digest-pinned minimal base and a non-root user.

items.prompt: Dockerfile: distroless base at a pinned digest, USER appuser, read-only rootfs. Container review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — pinned minimal base and non-root runtime is the hardening bar. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Pod spec: securityContext privileged: true and hostPID: true. K8s review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — privileged with hostPID is near-host root. FIRST ACTION: drop both, grant only needed capabilities.

items.prompt: Pod spec: no resources block at all. K8s review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — unbounded pods can starve node co-tenants. FIRST ACTION: requests and limits per workload class.

items.prompt: Pod spec: DB password via secretKeyRef from a K8s Secret, etcd encrypted. K8s review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — secret-based injection keeps the credential out of manifests. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Deployment: image: registry/app:latest, pullPolicy Always. K8s review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — latest means you cannot say what runs or roll back to it. FIRST ACTION: immutable tags/digests from CI.

items.prompt: Namespace: no NetworkPolicies, flat pod network. K8s review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — flat networking makes lateral movement free. FIRST ACTION: default-deny plus explicit allows.

items.prompt: Cluster: PSA restricted enforced; admission rejects privileged and hostPath. K8s review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — admission rejects privileged and hostPath specs, which beats conventions. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: RBAC: the app's service account binds cluster-admin. K8s review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — cluster-admin RBAC on the service account means any pod compromise becomes cluster compromise. FIRST ACTION: namespaced least-privilege role.

items.prompt: Pod mounts hostPath / into the container at /host. K8s review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — host root mounts are an escape primitive. FIRST ACTION: remove the mount or narrow it to a specific dir.

items.prompt: Code: API_KEY = 'sk_live_...' at module top. Secrets review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — hardcoded credentials live in every clone and rotation means a code change. FIRST ACTION: secret manager + env injection.

items.prompt: Code: API_KEY = os.environ['API_KEY'] injected by the platform secret store. Secrets review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — the env-injected credential never enters version control. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Practice: the same signing key since 2021, stored on the build server. Secrets review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — stale key on a shared host; generate a new key in the KMS and rotate with a dual-key overlap window.

items.prompt: Logger prints the full Authorization header at debug. Secrets review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — bearer tokens in logs spread across the pipeline. FIRST ACTION: log a token fingerprint only.

items.prompt: Practice: prod password lives in a pinned chat message, shared by all. Secrets review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — chat is not a secret store. FIRST ACTION: rotate, per-person vault credentials, audited access.

items.prompt: Web app: a 'client secret' is embedded in the JS bundle and sent as a header. Secrets review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — anything in the bundle is public. FIRST ACTION: server-issued session tokens instead.

items.prompt: CI: the prod deploy key is available to every workflow including fork PRs. Secrets review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — fork code with prod credentials is pipeline takeover. FIRST ACTION: scope to protected workflows or use OIDC.

items.prompt: Repo: .env with live keys was committed; repo is private. Secrets review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — private is not secret; rotate, gitignore, and purge history.

items.prompt: JWTs: HS256, secret in a plaintext file copied to every app server. Secrets review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — a replicated symmetric secret means any host forges every token. FIRST ACTION: asymmetric signing with the key in KMS.

items.prompt: Inventory: 40 vendor keys, all admin scope 'for convenience'. Secrets review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — over-privileged vendor keys turn any leak into account takeover. FIRST ACTION: audit scopes, request least privilege, delete unused.

items.prompt: Incident: live key in a public gist; team is 2h deep in finding who posted it; key still works. Call?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: wrong order — rotate the credential first, attribution can wait; every active hour is attacker time.

items.prompt: Incident: memory and disk captured before the rebuild; service restored in 2h. Call?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: correct sequence — evidence captured before restoration. VERDICT: well-run.

items.prompt: Incident: an engineer tweeted 'yeah we got hacked lol' mid-response. Call?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: comms discipline — one spokesperson, verified facts only, stated update cadence; have the post removed.

items.prompt: Incident: miner killed on one host, declared contained, no sweep. Call?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: not contained — find the entry vector, sweep all hosts, rotate what the host could read.

items.prompt: Incident: logs show user records read 3 weeks ago; leadership wants silence. Call?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: notify — data exposure triggers disclosure obligations; engage legal, reset credentials, prepare the disclosure.

items.prompt: Post-incident: attacker had admin; one account disabled, nothing else. Call?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: incomplete — enumerate accounts/keys created in the window, org-wide reset, audit for persistence.

items.prompt: Postmortem: action items are 'be more careful' with no owners. Call?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — rewrite each item with an owner, a date, and a verification step, tracked like releases.

items.prompt: On-call mutes the recurring alert 'because it always self-heals'. Call?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: unacceptable — muting hides slow-burn incidents; fix the flapping cause or split the alert.

items.prompt: Ransom note on staging; on-call rebooted the box. Call?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: stop touching it — isolate by network cut (not shutdown), snapshot disk, verify the exfiltration claim in egress logs.

items.prompt: Vendor email: 'your data may be involved'; team archived it. Call?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: demand written specifics (types, volume, dates), inventory what the vendor holds, prepare your own disclosure path.

items.prompt: Auth logging: successes only. Monitoring review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — without failure events, stuffing is invisible. FIRST ACTION: log all outcomes and alert on failure-rate spikes.

items.prompt: Audit log: same DB as app data, admins can edit rows. Monitoring review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — an editable audit log is not an audit trail. FIRST ACTION: append-only/WORM store outside admin reach.

items.prompt: Paging: 300 alerts/day, 95% auto-resolve, team ignores them. Monitoring review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — the ignored pager is noise; page on user-impact symptoms, move causes to dashboards, burn down noisy rules.

items.prompt: Charge handler logs the full request payload including card data. Monitoring review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — payment data in logs drags PCI onto the pipeline. FIRST ACTION: field whitelist, mask PANs, purge captured values.

items.prompt: Alerting: uptime and CPU only. Monitoring review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — infra alerts catch crashes, not compromise. FIRST ACTION: five starter rules — admin off-hours, impossible travel, mass export, role changes, new keys.

items.prompt: Retention: 7 days of logs; an investigated breach started 3 weeks ago. Monitoring review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — the evidence window is gone. FIRST ACTION: 90-day hot + 1-year archive for security logs.

items.prompt: Fleet: NTP off after an image change, 40s drift between hosts. Monitoring review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — drift breaks cross-service timeline correlation. FIRST ACTION: re-enable NTP, alert on drift, bake it into the baseline.

items.prompt: Dashboards: one 200-metric board, no SLOs. Monitoring review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — define 2-3 user-facing SLOs, alert on burn rate, cut the mega-board.

items.prompt: Logs: one shared index, PII unchecked, all-engineers read access. Monitoring review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — a shared PII index is a standing privacy incident. FIRST ACTION: scrub at ingestion, role-restrict, audit queries.

items.prompt: Detections: rules written in 2023, never exercised, MTTD unknown. Monitoring review.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: reject — untested detections are hypotheses. FIRST ACTION: attack-simulate each rule, record MTTD, repeat quarterly.

items.prompt: PR: db.query('SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = $1', [uid]) — parameterized, connection pooled. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — the parameterized query is correct. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Design: URL previews restricted to an allowlist, post-DNS private-IP blocks, 3s timeout. Threat model ssrf.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — allowlist plus private-IP blocking closes the ssrf path. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Code: token = os.environ['SERVICE_TOKEN'] from the platform secret store; never logged. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — env-injected secret with no logging is the correct pattern. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Dockerfile: distroless@sha256 pinned, USER nonroot, read-only rootfs. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — pinned minimal base with non-root runtime is the hardening bar. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: API: charges require Idempotency-Key; duplicates return the stored response. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — idempotency keys make retries safe. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Workflow: pull_request event, all actions SHA-pinned, no secrets exposed. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — unprivileged event with pinned actions is correct. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Handler logs order_id and amount only; a lint rule blocks payload logging. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — field whitelisting with lint enforcement is correct. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Tenancy: RLS keyed to a session tenant variable; unfiltered queries fail closed. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — database-enforced isolation fails closed. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Diff: realpath containment check with 403 outside the root. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — realpath containment blocks traversal. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Incident: leaked key rotated in 10 minutes, history preserved, comms drafted. Call?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: correct sequence — rotation first, evidence preserved. VERDICT: well-run.

items.prompt: API: every object route 403s unless the resource belongs to the caller. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — per-object ownership checks close idor. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Namespace: default-deny NetworkPolicy with explicit per-dependency allows. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — default-deny plus named allows is correct. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Logger prints user id and an 8-char token fingerprint. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — fingerprints are safe to log and correlate sessions. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Admin panel: internal-only binding, SSO with MFA. Threat model exposure.
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — internal binding with MFA removes the anonymous surface. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Releases: ephemeral runners, OIDC registry creds, cosign signatures. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — short-lived creds plus signed artifacts is correct. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Audit log: WORM bucket, hash-chained records, no admin edit rights. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — write-once with tamper evidence is correct. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: East-west: mTLS with per-workload identities from the mesh. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — per-workload mTLS removes implicit network trust. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Webhook: HMAC-SHA256 over raw body, constant-time compare, 5-min window. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — the verification pattern is correct. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: List API: server-side limit cap of 50 with cursor pagination. Finding?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: no finding — server-side caps bound request cost. VERDICT: approve.

items.prompt: Postmortem: each action item has owner, due date, verification, linked ticket. Call?
items.reference: RECOMMENDATION: solid follow-through — owned, dated, verifiable items. VERDICT: well-run.
